settings.heading: Honey the way nature intended
settings.pills: Raw honey, Single origin, 100% pure honey

settings.title: Gathering nectar
settings.text: Bees use their straw-like tongues to extract nectar from flowers, storing it in a specialised “honey stomach” for transport back to the hive.

settings.title: Transforming & dehydrating
settings.text: Inside the hive, bees add enzymes to break down the nectar’s sugars, then deposit it into honeycomb cells. They fan their wings to evaporate moisture before sealing the cells with wax.

settings.title: Harvesting & jarring
settings.text: Beekeepers remove the wax caps and spin the frames in an extractor. The honey is then filtered and bottled, preserving nature’s golden sweetness in every jar.
